# Happy Collector

Canonical play URL: https://kids-happy-collector.vercel.app/
Itch.io: https://joenasr.itch.io/happy-collector
Repository: https://github.com/Joenasriani/kids-happy-collector

Happy Collector is a 20-level Three.js browser platformer developed as part of a multi-game interactive children's edutainment activation in the UAE.

The player controls a smiling yellow cube across floating platform routes. Yellow blocks carry positive emotions and qualities such as BRAVERY, JOY, LOVE, HOPE, PEACE, KINDNESS, CALM, PRIDE, TRUST and HAPPINESS. Red enemies carry negative emotions and behaviors such as ANGER, GREED, JEALOUSY, RUDENESS, ENVY, HATE and DESPAIR.

Core interaction: move and jump → collect positive blocks (+10) → avoid or stomp negative enemies (+5 for a stomp) → navigate platform challenges → reach the level door → advance.

The game includes horizontal moving platforms, vertical lifts, pendulum platforms, curved and rope-bridge sequences, button-controlled gates, button-raised steps, cracking glass platforms and enemy patrol sections. Collecting every positive block is not required for progression.

The game has 20 levels. Levels are built from reusable platform and obstacle definitions. Levels 11 to 20 use layouts defined directly in the code. Level 20 is the final level.

The repository includes the complete playable game in index.html, a local Three.js runtime, music, sound effects, fonts, and level/QA documentation. Original game source code and owned documentation are MIT licensed. Third-party assets and branding are excluded from that grant.
